title: Binance Adds UMA on Cross Margin, PEPE & SUI Pairs on Isolated Margin
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance has added   UMA  as a new  borrowable asset  on  Cross   Margin,  as well as new trading pairs on  Isolated Margin : New Cross Margin Pair:   UMA/USDT New Isolated Margin Pairs:  PEPE/TUSD ,  SUI/TUSD Explore Binance Margin Now!
